QUOTE: `skipSync: true` | add path, `reactions.ts:28` | `sanitizeReactions` returns `deleteReactions: []` before the diff (`utils/reaction.ts:49`). The one-reaction payload is not treated as the full reaction set, so the handler does not delete every other reaction on the post.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly states that skipSync prevents the single-reaction payload being treated as the full set, which would otherwise delete all other reactions on the post.
